name: NGED connections homepage
fact: NGED provides budget estimates, applications, connection information and Clearview transparency tools.
gate: A portal route or budget estimate is not a connection offer or planning permission.

name: NGED connection offer expenses
fact: NGED explains connection-offer expenses and distinguishes free budget estimates from formal connection-offer work.
gate: Paying/receiving an offer expense assessment does not itself secure capacity or acceptance.

name: NGED distributed generation
fact: NGED publishes G99/DCODE/ENA distributed-generation connection guidance.
gate: Technical application guidance does not establish a project's approval or export capacity.

name: NGED budget estimate
fact: NGED's tool produces an indicative connection cost and excludes items including some site works, permits, legal requirements and consents.
gate: An indicative budget estimate is not a formal connection offer or engineering-capacity confirmation.

name: NGED types of connection offer
fact: NGED distinguishes budget estimates from formal connection offers that set works, costs and terms.
gate: Budget estimate and formal offer states must remain separate.

name: NGED connections pricing guide
fact: NGED states published connection prices are indicative and actual costs depend on project requirements and site conditions.
gate: Typical price or lead-time data must not be stored as a site-specific quote.

name: NGED storage G99 application
fact: NGED requires location/site plans and technical specifications for G99 storage connection applications.
gate: Application submission is not approval, export permission or reserved network capacity.

name: SSEN generation availability and capacity dataset
fact: SSEN publishes generation availability, contracted demand and major-substation capacity information for north and south licence areas.
gate: Capacity-map values are indicative and do not replace a connection study/offer.

name: SSEN tools and maps
fact: SSEN links LTDS, Network Capacity Information, its data portal and near-real-time data tools.
gate: Tool availability does not establish spare capacity for a target site.

name: SSEN connect 5+ properties
fact: SSEN requires site/layout, demand, land-ownership and timing information for larger residential connection applications.
gate: Application completeness and requested load are not an accepted connection or delivery date.

name: SSEN large new connections
fact: SSEN notes design changes, site readiness and material lead times can delay large connections.
gate: Indicative process timing must not be converted into a guaranteed energisation date.

name: SSEN low-carbon technology connections dataset
fact: SSEN's January 2026 dataset aggregates EV, heat-pump, solar and battery connection counts/capacity at primary-substation level.
gate: Aggregated LCT capacity is not spare headroom or a target site's connection status.

name: ENWL heatmap tool
fact: SP Electricity North West's heatmap was updated 30 June 2026 and explicitly says formal detailed assessment is more accurate.
gate: Heatmap spare capacity is total indicative capacity and not the maximum size of one connection or an approval.

name: ENWL connections data portal
fact: The portal links current heatmap, Embedded Capacity Register and other connection datasets.
gate: Dataset availability is screening evidence, not reserved capacity.

name: ENWL digital service catalogue
fact: The catalogue identifies the Heatmap Tool and online connection services as planning/support resources.
gate: Digital-service outputs remain pre-assessment unless converted into a formal offer.

name: ENWL connection FAQs
fact: ENWL states connection cost/time depend on scale, location, reinforcement, permits, land rights and other consents.
gate: Average/typical times and costs must not be applied to a specific development without an offer.

name: ENWL releasing capacity
fact: ENWL describes capacity-release actions and transmission constraints affecting larger projects while noting local distribution constraints are managed separately.
gate: Network-wide released-capacity claims do not reserve headroom for a target connection.

name: SPEN distribution heat map
fact: SPEN says the webpage heatmap is based on October 2025 data and no longer updated, directing users to the Open Data Portal for latest capacity data.
gate: Do not use the legacy webpage map as current capacity evidence.

name: SPEN alternative DG connection offers
fact: SPEN lists non-firm, ANM, export-limit and other alternative connection products for constrained areas.
gate: Alternative/flexible connection terms must not be scored as firm unrestricted capacity.

name: SPEN accelerating distribution connections
fact: SPEN explains Technical Limits can enable eligible flexible connections ahead of transmission reinforcement, subject to ANM and curtailment.
gate: Acceleration through Technical Limits is conditional and does not equal firm capacity or guaranteed timing.

name: SPEN transmission connections
fact: SPEN provides transmission heatmap and application-process guidance using NESO TEC information as high-level pre-application context.
gate: Transmission heatmap/TEC context is not a formal connection offer.

name: Northern Powergrid ECR 1MW+
fact: Northern Powergrid's ECR lists generation, storage and flexible-demand assets connected or accepted to connect, with status, capacity and dates, updated monthly.
gate: Accepted-to-connect records must not be treated as energised assets or spare capacity.

name: Northern Powergrid ECR under 1MW
fact: Northern Powergrid publishes ECR records for assets from 50kW to under 1MW that are connected or accepted to connect.
gate: Register presence is not a target site's headroom or connection offer.

name: Northern Powergrid portal dashboards
fact: Northern Powergrid dashboards allow data to be filtered by GSP, primary substation or local authority and note some data requires registration.
gate: Dashboard aggregation is screening/context and does not establish a project-specific network study.

name: Northern Powergrid feature-page dataset
fact: Northern Powergrid's portal index links Embedded Capacity Register, generation dashboard, GSP dashboard and flexibility-service resources.
gate: A discovery/index page is not capacity or connection evidence by itself.
